sources.articleTitle: Modernist artist Arpita Singh, aged 89, passes away

headline: Renowned Modernist Indian Artist Arpita Singh Passes Away At 89
metaDescription: Acclaimed Indian artist Arpita Singh, celebrated for her contributions to modern art, has passed away at the age of 89. She was a Padma Bhushan recipient.
aiSummaryBullets: Arpita Singh, a prominent figure in the Indian modernist art scene, has died at the age of 89.
She was honored with the Padma Bhushan in 2011 for her significant work in the arts.
In 2014, she received the Lalit Kala Akademi Fellowship recognizing her ongoing contributions to the art community.
aiContextParagraph: Arpita Singh was a distinguished modernist artist known for her profound impact on the Indian art landscape. Throughout her career, she received several notable recognitions for her creative contributions. Among her most prominent honors was the Padma Bhushan, which was awarded to her in 2011 in recognition of her services to the country through her artistic endeavors. Additionally, the Lalit Kala Akademi, India's national academy of fine arts, bestowed upon her a fellowship in 2014. These awards highlight her standing as a major figure within the contemporary art world. Her passing at age 89 marks the end of a long career that saw her work celebrated for its unique modernist perspective. She remains a significant figure in historical records of Indian artistic development, leaving behind a legacy that continues to be acknowledged by cultural institutions and fellow artists throughout the country.
